remarks:
*Your own private pond and peaceful country retreat!* Escape the hustle and bustle and discover this
charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath home surrounded by beautiful green space, mature trees, and picturesque
country scenery. Perched on a gentle hillside, the home features an expansive wraparound covered deck
overlooking the property and pond—an incredible spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining, entertaining, or
simply relaxing and enjoying the views! Inside, you'll find a comfortable, inviting living room, an eat-in
kitchen with updated stainless steel stove, dishwasher, and microwave, wood-look flooring, and convenient
laundry facilities. Recent improvements include a durable metal roof installed approximately two years ago,
well servicing in 2023, and a water filtration system. The home also features a walkout lower level, offering
additional storage and utility space. Outside, the spacious grounds offer room to garden, play, entertain, or
simply enjoy the peaceful natural surroundings. A detached two-car garage provides additional room for
vehicles, equipment, and hobbies, while the property's pond adds a truly special touch to the setting. A
natural gas-powered backup generator offers additional convenience. Whether you're searching for a yearround home, a weekend escape, or a quiet getaway surrounded by nature, this property offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy country living. *Come see the views, explore the grounds, and experience this unique setting for yourself!*
